reviews.title: Truly Awful
reviews.text:
To state that the app enables easy setup is ludicrous. This might be the worst app I’ve ever attempted to use. 

WiFi setup fails repeatedly , even though I’ve tried every troubleshooting step which LaCrosse advises. Having decided to opt out of WiFi, there’s no way to get out of the network search and the WiFi icon continuously flashes. I’m no longer opting into something that does not work, can we at least stop with the annoying flashing icon?

Probably the fact that my station (C84428) is old is to blame, but can’t the vendor just fess up and admit the device is not supported? Instead support articles provides step by step tasks certain to fail, wasting hours. 

It’s time to find a station that works and put much distance between myself, my time and effort and this truly terrible app and user experience.

reviews.title: Rain Total
reviews.text: The rain amount for the 24 hour period frequently doubles.  The rain amount on the weather station will be correct: for example, weather station 24 hour total will read 1.00 inches but the app 24 hour total will read 2.00 inches. This problem continues despite several updates.

reviews.title: Lacrosse Weather Station
reviews.text:
I would never buy a Lacrosse weather station again. It does not stay connected to wifi and does not want to connect to the app. I’ve had this for 2+ years. Hasn’t updated in 5 days 6hrs quite possibly the worst weather station on the market. “Just updated “ shows no outside temp. This app and device are probably the worst on the market, I’ll never buy another one!! Wednesday 4/3/24 say updated 3hrs ago no temps displayed indoor or outdoor. What a joke!
I updated on 4/3 and got the app to link up.
On 4/6 app only shows indoor temp, says last updated 2days and x # of hrs ago. If you have to update the app or refresh the wifi every other day then the product is defective. It doesn’t even deserve a star.

reviews.title: App OK, Hardware Garbage
reviews.text: The app works great. However, the equipment is garbage. Even with new batteries all the sensors frequently go offline. They are not even far apart from their receiver. I daily get four beeps from the base unit with no notification as to why. As a weather expert I will be upgrading my equipment. However, it won’t be with Lacrosse.
